summary: Analysis of sqlite3 and database usage in the VoiceBot codebase. The app uses Sequelize as the sole database layer; sqlite3 is used indirectly when DB_DIALECT is set to sqlite.

items.usage: Not required directly in application code. Sequelize uses sqlite3 as the default driver when dialect is 'sqlite'.
No direct require() or usage found in the codebase. Likely unused or a transitive/optional dependency.
No direct require() or usage found in the codebase.
Single database abstraction layer. Connects using env (DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HOST, DB_DIALECT). When DB_DIALECT is 'sqlite', Sequelize loads and uses the sqlite3 driver.

usage: db.sync().then(...) — Syncs schema before starting HTTP server; then users.sync() and conversations.sync().
createUser(): INSERT INTO users_demobot (callSID, PhoneNumber, Name, status, interested, voicemail, email, country, createdAt) via db.query(sql, { replacements }).
insertConversation(): INSERT INTO conversations_demobot (callSID, PhoneNumber, role, content, timestamp, createdAt) via db.query(sql, { replacements }).
getUsers(): SELECT callSID, PhoneNumber, name, createdAt FROM users_demobot via db.query(sql).
getConversations(): SELECT ... FROM conversations_demobot WHERE callSID = ? via db.query(sql, { replacements: [callSID] }).

findings.title: Direct sqlite3 or better-sqlite3 usage
findings.finding: There are no direct require('sqlite3') or require('better-sqlite3') or require('sqlite') calls in the application or test code. All database access goes through Sequelize (Sequelize/db.js).

findings.title: Where sqlite3 is used
summary_points: sqlite3 is used only indirectly: when process.env.DB_DIALECT is 'sqlite', Sequelize loads and uses the sqlite3 package to connect and run queries.
The only database entry point is Sequelize/db.js; all reads/writes use db.query() or Sequelize models.
better-sqlite3 and the 'sqlite' package appear unused in the codebase and could be candidates for removal from package.json if not required by another dependency.
Tables touched: users_demobot (users/call metadata), conversations_demobot (conversation content per call).

scope: Project root excluding node_modules; JS and JSON files only.
